source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check DIMM information and detail information.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes `/Systems/system/Memory`, requests MemorySummary plus `.Dimms|length` with insecure curl, and omits standard collection member traversal, physical slot mapping, per-DIMM identity/capacity/speed/health and empty-slot semantics.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly restores complete per-slot topology/population and no-fault/no-reseat controls, but treats the finite slot map and build recipe as a continuing decision.

old_problem: Aggregate capacity/count can look correct while DIMMs are swapped, installed in wrong channels, degraded, missing or represented by incorrect service labels. The suggested collection shape is also non-portable. The previous review identified these gaps but left Pending for the Project CPU/channel/slot topology and population recipe instead of treating them as execution prerequisites.
disposition_reason: Discover the actual ComputerSystem and Memory collection, traverse every member/page, bind each member and every documented empty/disabled socket to the approved CPU/socket/controller/channel/slot/service-label topology, and compare full per-slot identity/capacity/type/speed/status/error data plus actual WebUI detail to the build recipe. Summary/count remains only a reconciled aggregate check.
decision_basis: XLSX row 969, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 970 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 970 / variant 1ed8e556dc05cb18.

DMTF Memory resources provide MemoryLocation fields for Socket, MemoryController, Channel and Slot and may also expose a service label/part location; those fields must be reconciled with the physical silkscreen map instead of relying on collection order.

A standard Memory endpoint is a collection of member links, not an inline `.Dimms` array. ComputerSystem MemorySummary and member counts are cross-checks only and cannot establish per-slot correctness.

Empty, intentionally unpopulated, disabled, absent-resource, inaccessible and failed DIMM states have different acceptance meaning and require the Project population recipe and target representation rules.

ED-02, ED-08, ED-14, ED-15, ED-16, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 preserve per-slot identity, visual evidence, thresholds and no-injection scope; ED-33 through ED-38 permit safe Project parameterization without summary-based coverage reduction.

test_case.test_name: Validate every physical DIMM slot, population, module identity and health independently
test_case.purpose: Verify every Project-defined CPU/socket/memory-controller/channel/DIMM slot is independently accounted as correctly populated, intentionally empty, disabled or unsupported, and that each installed module's capacity, technology/form factor, manufacturer/part/serial, configured/operating speed, state/health and supported error data match the build recipe and actual BMC WebUI without physical intervention.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/system/BIOS/memory-configuration/WebUI identity and complete CPU socket/controller/channel/DIMM physical slot/service-label topology
Approved population recipe marking every slot fitted, intentionally empty, disabled or unsupported with expected module capacity/type/form factor/manufacturer/part/serial and configured speed
Service-root-discovered ComputerSystem and paginated Memory collection/member resources with supported Memory schema versions and stable member-to-slot association
Per-field semantics for CapacityMiB, MemoryType/MemoryDeviceType/BaseModuleType, OperatingSpeedMhz or configured speed, Status.State/Health and supported error/status fields
Interface-specific rules for empty/absent/disabled/unavailable slots, aggregate MemorySummary/count/total reconciliation and data freshness
Actual WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs DIMM table/detail mapping, trusted TLS/protected credentials and serial/part redaction/evidence storage
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify immutable target, discover the selected ComputerSystem and its Memory collection from links, traverse all collection pages and retrieve every `Members[].@odata.id`; do not assume system ID `system`, `.Dimms` or collection order. Preserve complete redacted member records and bind each to the approved physical CPU/socket/controller/channel/slot using MemoryLocation, Location.PartLocation.ServiceLabel and durable vendor mapping. Build one row for every physical slot, including expected empty/disabled/unsupported slots that may lack a member. For installed DIMMs record Id/Name, location, CapacityMiB, MemoryType, MemoryDeviceType, BaseModuleType, manufacturer, part, serial, rank/data-width fields when supported, allowed/configured/operating speed, Status.State/Health and supported error/log/metrics links with timestamps. Open and capture the actual rendered WebUI DIMM table and every required detail, reconcile all per-slot fields and then cross-check aggregate installed count/capacity against the sum and supported MemorySummary. Keep empty, disabled, absent, unauthorized, stale and failed distinct. Do not clear logs, inject ECC/memory faults, change BIOS/memory configuration, reseat DIMMs, reset, reboot or power-cycle.
test_case.expected_result: Every physical DIMM slot appears exactly once in the matrix with the approved population state and no duplicate/swapped location. Each installed module maps to the correct socket/controller/channel/slot and matches its expected capacity, type/form factor, manufacturer/part/serial, speed and acceptable state/health/error policy. Each empty/disabled/unsupported slot has the documented interface representation. Actual WebUI and complete API members reconcile within freshness tolerance, aggregate count/capacity equals the per-slot sum and build recipe, and no memory or system state changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete page/member traversal, explicit every-slot accounting, topology-backed identity, per-installed-DIMM field/health comparison, authoritative empty/disabled semantics, actual rendered WebUI detail and aggregate reconciliation. MemorySummary, DIMM count or total capacity alone cannot pass. Missing/extra/duplicate/swapped module, wrong slot/part/capacity/type/speed, stale/unacceptable health/error, unapproved absence or UI/API/build mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology/population/health policy is NOT READY rather than Pending; no health threshold or empty-slot rule is invented.
safety_gate: Use only certificate-verified protected inventory GET/read operations; do not expose DIMM serials/parts or assume fixed system/member identifiers.
Map every resource to physical CPU/controller/channel/slot/service label through the approved topology; collection order and member Id alone are insufficient.
Distinguish intentionally empty, disabled, unsupported, absent-resource, inaccessible, stale and failed states; none may be silently collapsed.
Prohibit ECC/RAS injection, stress stimulus, BIOS or memory configuration changes, DIMM reseat/removal, log clearing, reset, reboot and power actions.
Retain complete raw per-member data and actual rendered WebUI evidence before normalization/redaction; use protected stable tokens for serial correlation.
Stop on duplicate/ambiguous slot mapping, stale health, unexpected error data or authority conflict and do not automatically retry with reset/reseat/power.
expected_evidence: Immutable target/schema/WebUI identity and approved complete CPU/socket/controller/channel/DIMM topology/population recipe
Complete paginated Memory collection and protected raw member artifacts with links, timestamps and hashes
Every-slot matrix with physical label, expected/observed population, module identity, capacity/type/form factor/speed, state/health/errors and per-field outcome
Actual rendered WebUI DIMM table and detail visual artifacts with per-slot API/UI/build reconciliation
Aggregate member count/capacity/summary recomputation from accepted per-slot rows and explicit empty/disabled/unsupported accounting
Preserved SEL/audit evidence, no-injection/no-config/no-reseat/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On ambiguous/duplicate slot mapping, missing module, stale health, error or UI/API/build mismatch, stop and preserve/redact evidence and obtain the authoritative topology/recipe. Do not clear logs, inject faults, change memory configuration, reseat DIMMs, reset, reboot, power-cycle or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: Master consistently requests DIMM information/detail correctness. DeepSeek's summary/count query is a coverage omission, not a conflicting source purpose.

blocked.reason: Complete safe DIMM inventory validation is standard and technically defined. Physical topology, population and field/health expectations are bounded Project prerequisites.
